title: FOOD-005A — Package / SKU identity domain
scope: Pure local immutable package/SKU snapshots; independent of the pending FOOD-004K real gnocchi cooking run. Synthetic tests only.
discovery: No canonical FOOD Package/SKU type found. Existing serving offers have optional descriptive packaging text; FOOD-003D portions and candidate prices remain internal planning, not package/SKU identities. Generic commerce/order/provider references are separate domains.

contract.package: FoodPackageDefinitionVersion { id: FoodPackageDefinitionId; version; descriptor?; netQuantity?: { basis: grams; grams } }. Physical configuration identity distinct from its contents, serving offer and SKU. Facts may remain absent without becoming inferred values.
contract.sku: FoodSkuVersion { id: FoodSkuId; version; servingOffer: { offerId; version }; package: { id; version } }. Exact packaged commercial configuration; preserves serving offer -> presentation -> product/recipe hierarchy without duplicating downstream fields.
contract.identity: food-package-definition and food-sku prefixes with nonempty, unpadded local strings of at most 128 UTF-16 characters and no colon. Explicit create/parse functions; no coercion or generation.
contract.quantity: Optional net quantity supports positive finite grams at most MAX_SAFE_INTEGER via existing FOOD gram validator; fractions retained. Count-based packaging deferred: no bounded current requirement establishes its meaning. Count/ounces/pounds/cups/pieces rejected, never converted to mass.
contract.descriptor: Optional explicit bounded unpadded nonempty text, at most 500 characters; no package-kind taxonomy invented.
contract.references: Canonical serving-offer ID parser and version validator; exact package ID/version parser. Shape validation only: no dependency resolution, existence/completeness claim, snapshot comparison, latest/current/fallback lookup or storage access.
contract.versioning: Positive safe integers. Explicit revision helpers require same identity and consecutive versions, rejecting overflow. Full replacement snapshots; SKU relationships may change only in a deliberately supplied new version, never by retargeting existing values. No durable uniqueness enforcement.
contract.immutability: Strict own-key allowlists including symbols; new detached nested records frozen along with outer snapshots. Unknown fields rejected.
contract.merchantCode: Deferred: canonical identity suffices for exact downstream references; no established merchant-code uniqueness/normalization policy. UPC/GTIN/barcode remain separate future work.
contract.formats: SKU imposes no serving-format restriction or duplicate format fields. Existing individual/family/catering/custom offers can later be referenced; kits/standalone/prepared meals require separately authorized actual offers/packages. Shared lower-level food does not imply shared SKU.

boundaries: PRODUCT != RECIPE != RECIPE VERSION != COMPONENT != DISH PRESENTATION != SERVING OFFER != PACKAGE != SKU != PRICE != AVAILABILITY != ORDERABILITY != INVENTORY != CART LINE != ORDER LINE. Valid identity confers no publication, safety/legal/sale readiness. No approved or candidate prices, stock/reservation, tax/payment/provider fields, public projection or persistence.
existingFileChanges: NONE; validators reused without additive exports.
compatibility: FOOD-001, FOOD-002B/C/D, FOOD-003D and FOOD-004A/B/C unchanged. projectFoodPublicMenu remains unchanged and does not expose package/SKU. FOOD-004K introduces no real food facts.
validation: Full FOOD suite including FOOD-002B/C, FOOD-003D and FOOD-004A/B/C
operations: Implementation authorized no actual food/package/SKU records, persistence, infrastructure, production D1/KV/Cloudflare access, deployment, staging, commit or push. Subsequent owner closure authorization permits local review/corrections and exact staging of the three FOOD-005A files only. Commit/push remain unauthorized. FOOD-005B approved commercial-price bridge remains future work.
